modules.goal: Implement error classes, regex tokens and AST parser with RE2 subset validation and limit enforcement.
acceptance: IF the pattern contains a backreference '(a)\1' or lookaround '(?=a)' THEN compile throws UnsupportedFeatureError with code 'UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE'
IF the pattern is '[a-' or '(abc' THEN compile throws RegexSyntaxError with code 'PARSE_ERROR' and a position of at least 0
WHEN pattern length exceeds default maxPatternLength 4096 or nesting exceeds maxDepth 64 THEN compile throws LimitExceededError with code 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED'

modules.goal: Build Thompson NFA with epsilon transitions, character ranges, anchors and UTF-16 code point decoding.
acceptance: WHEN compile('^.$').test('\uD83D\uDE00') runs THEN it returns true, because matching is by code point (U+1F600 is one character)
WHEN an NFA is constructed for 'a|b' THEN state count is at least 4 and matches input 'a' returning step count of at least 1

modules.goal: Implement dual execution engines with lazy DFA (LRU cache) for test/exec and Pike VM for full submatch extraction.
acceptance: WHEN compile('(a+)+$').test runs on 'a'.repeat(n) + 'b' for n = 10000 and n = 100000 THEN both return false and lastStats().steps for n = 100000 is at most 11 times the value for n = 10000
WHEN each of the 10 documented pathological patterns, including '(a|aa)*b', runs on inputs of 10000 and 100000 code points THEN the step ratio stays at most 11
WHEN compile('(?:a|b)*c').test('abac') runs THEN it returns true and lastStats().engine is 'dfa'
WHEN compile('(?P<id>[a-z]+):(?P<val>\d+)').exec('foo:42') runs THEN groups equals { id: 'foo', val: '42' } and index is 0
WHEN lazy DFA encounters more than 10000 states THEN LRU eviction occurs and execution falls back to 'pike'

modules.goal: Provide LinearRegex public facade, compile, replace, matchAll and lastStats tracking.
acceptance: WHEN replace('hello world', '$2, $1') runs with pattern '(\w+)\s(\w+)' THEN it returns 'world, hello'
WHEN matchAll is invoked with pattern '\d+' on 'item 10 and 20' THEN match array has length 2 and matches '10' and '20'

modules.goal: Deliver CI differential conformance testing against re2-wasm, fast-check property tests and documentation.
acceptance: WHEN the CI conformance job compares 50000 seeded random pattern and input pairs from the subset with re2-wasm THEN at least 99 percent agree on match, index and captures and the job prints the agreement percentage
WHEN docs/PROJECT.md is read THEN it contains section heading 'Line comparison metrics' with empty results table
